questions.prompt: Why does a smaller tool list help an expert?
options: The model has fewer wrong actions to pick from, and the prompt is shorter
The model runs on a faster server when it has fewer tools
pi refuses to start with more than four tools
Tools can only be used by one expert at a time
questions.explanation: Fewer tools means fewer wrong actions, and a shorter prompt leaves more room in the context window.

questions.prompt: Two experts in fleet answer different kinds of question. What differs between them?
options: They use different packs on the same model
They use different session log formats
questions.explanation: The model is the same for all three experts. Only the domain pack differs.

questions.prompt: Where should the rule 'revenue excludes refunded orders' live?
options: In the model, which will learn it by guessing
In the domain pack, as a file the expert reads
questions.explanation: A model cannot guess a rule that is true only for your shop. The domain pack holds such rules as files.
